chapter: Russell's band, records and Armstrong in the studio
title: Three bands at once, and why the Empire Ballroom failed
summary: Holmes played one engagement with three bands, mostly playing cards; Carter opened the Empire and Russell followed, but the new room could not compete with Roseland and Arcadia.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: And with three bands, it was even better.

Now, you mentioned that Benny Carter, you thought, opened the Empire Ballroom...
He opened it, yeah. I don't know how long he stayed in there.

But shortly after that I think you said the Empire couldn't survive...

Oh, no, it couldn't survive with the big boys, the Roseland and the Arcadia. You know, I mean, the Roseland had been an established place for years, and so was the Arcadia. And this other place was coming up brand-new. They just couldn't...
Yeah, that's right. You know, the big ones eat up the little ones.
